The multi-asset book's sleeve-inclusion rule (Sharpe>=0.30, >=3 years history, no null test, 17 sleeves screened) is the weakest development bar of any family in the registry -- weaker than even the old flat 0.5 gate, let alone the post-amendment 1.8-2.4/sqrt(T) standard, and it screens the most candidates (17) with zero multiple-testing correction.

Noted for completeness, not as a defect: A's development active Sharpe (0.569) clears its Sharpe gate (0.520), but its Bonferroni-adjusted bootstrap p (0.023) misses the batch threshold (0.01667), so the family correctly failed overall.
